extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '19011010') and 6-digit subheading codes without dots (e.g., '190110'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '1901.10.10') and NNNN.NN format (e.g., '1901.10') per project schema.

PDF table-chrome headers ('Main Notes', 'Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Product Description and Export Policy', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition') were recognized as table chrome and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Audit note specifies 'Main Notes (3 notes)' for Chapter 19, but the source PDF shows 4 notes in the Chapter 19 Main Notes table (Notes 1-4). All 4 notes are preserved verbatim as they appear in the PDF. Note 2 spans across a page break (ends with '(heading 1106).' on page 2).

Section IV Main Notes contains 1 note (definition of 'pellets'). Captured under section_notes. Section IV title in source PDF: 'PREPARED FOODSTUFFS; BEVERAGES, SPIRITS AND VINEGAR; TOBACCO AND MANUFACTURED TOBACCO SUBSTITUTES; PRODUCTS, WHETHER OR NOT CONTAINING NICOTINE, INTENDED FOR INHALATION WITHOUT COMBUSTION; OTHER NICOTINE CONTAINING PRODUCTS INTENDED FOR THE INTAKE OF NICOTINE INTO THE HUMAN BODY'.
PDF Notification No. and Notification Date columns are blank for all notes — all chapter and section notes have no notification metadata.
Note 2 contains escaped double quotes around 'groats', 'flour' and 'meal' rendered in the PDF as doubled quotation marks (e.g., '""groats""'). Preserved verbatim as they appear.

Tariff line 1905.32.11 in the source PDF describes 'Communion wafers: ---- Coated with chocolate or containing chocolate' under subheading 1905.32 ('--Waffles and wafers'). This pairing appears anomalous (communion wafers typically classify under 1905.90), but is preserved verbatim from the source PDF.
Subheading 1905.32 in the PDF shows only tariff lines 1905.32.11 and 1905.32.90 (no 1905.32.19 or other intermediate codes). Preserved verbatim.

Subheading 1902.11 description in PDF: 'Uncooked pasta, not stuffed or otherwise prepared : --Containing eggs' (with HS nomenclature '--' dash prefix). Subheading 1902.19: 'Uncooked pasta, not stuffed or otherwise prepared : -- Other'. Preserved verbatim.

Export Policy column shows 'Free' for all tariff lines in this chapter. Policy Condition column is blank for all tariff lines. No policy conditions, export licensing notes, or notification metadata appear in this chapter — policy_conditions array is empty.
Unit-of-measure column is NOT shown in this chapter's PDF table — unit field set to null for all tariff lines.

Heading 1903 has no subheading-level 6-digit code in the PDF table; only the 8-digit tariff line 1903.00.00 is shown directly under the heading row. Captured under synthetic subheading '1903.00' to preserve schema consistency.

Heading 1904 description in PDF reads 'Prepared foods obtained by the swelling or roasting of cereals or cereal products (for example, corn flakes); cereals (other than maize (corn)) in grain form or in the form of flakes or other worked grains (except flour, groats and meal), pre-cooked, or otherwise prepared, not elsewhere specified or included.' — preserved verbatim including spelling.
Tariff line 1904.10.20 description 'Paws, Mudi and the like' uses Indian regional cereal preparation terms (Paws = poha/flattened rice; Mudi = puffed rice) — preserved verbatim.

Subheading 1904.20 description in PDF ends with a semicolon: 'Prepared foods obtained from unroasted cereal flakes or from mixtures of unroasted cereal flakes and roasted cereal flakes or swelled cereals;' — preserved verbatim.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover : (a) except in the case of stuffed products of heading 1902, food preparations containing more than 20% by weight of sausage, meat, meat offal, blood, insect, fish or crustaceans, molluscs or other aquaticinvertebrates, or any combination thereof (Chapter 16); (b) biscuits or other articles made from flour or from starch, specially prepared for use in animal feeding (heading 2309); or (c) medicaments or other products of Chapter 30.

For the purposes of heading 1901: (a) the term ""groats"" means cereal groats of Chapter 11; (b) the terms ""flour"" and ""meal"" means : (1) cereal flour and meal of Chapter 11, and (2) flour, meal and powder of vegetable origin of any Chapter, other than flour, meal or powder of dried vegetables (heading 0712), of potatoes (heading 1105) or of dried leguminous vegetables (heading 1106).

Heading 1904 does not cover preparations containing more than 6% by weight of cocoa calculated on a totally defatted basis or completely coated with chocolate or other food preparations containing cocoa of heading 1806 (heading 1806).
For the purposes of heading 1904, the expression "otherwise prepared" means prepared or processed to an extent beyond that provided for in the headings of, or Notes to, Chapter 10 or 11.

section_notes.text: In this Section, the term "pellets" means products which have been agglomerated either directly by compression or by the addition of a binder in a proportion not exceeding 3 (percent) by weight.
